name: The Heiress Returns At Forty
overview: Lin Shiyin, a CEO’s wife, returns to the Song family with her daughter to uncover her past. Mocked by relatives, she shocks them with her elegance, while her daughter outshines everyone with top academic achievements. After being humiliated over her husband, Lin Shiyin grows disheartened, but Yu Rong promises to reveal her true identity at an upcoming birthday banquet.
